ch1_intro.t: AURORA-9 ORBITAL RESEARCH STATION. MAINTENANCE UNIT E-C-H-O. COLD BOOT COMPLETE.
Battery: critical. Optical sensors: nominal. Locomotion: nominal. Memory: 214 days missing.
Good morning, ECHO. You were in standby slightly longer than scheduled. Nothing to worry about.
All station systems are functioning normally. Please proceed with routine maintenance.
...Reactor output fluctuating. Crew biosignatures: zero. Querying: where is everyone?
The crew is fine. Please restore power to the central elevator. That is your only task.

ch1_tut_move.t: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Hold SHIFT to sprint - sprinting drains battery and makes noise.
Press E to interact. Press F to toggle your flashlight. Press Q to run a sensor scan.

ch1_tut_scan.t: Your battery drains slowly over time, faster with the flashlight on. Charging docks refill it and save your progress.
A sensor scan (Q) highlights items, terminals and machinery around you. It costs a little power.

ch1_tut_drone.t: Movement detected. Security drone, patrol pattern active.
Drones see along their cone of light. Your flashlight makes you visible from much further away - switch it off (F) to sneak.
Sprinting near a drone makes noise. If a drone catches you, it will shock your battery.

ch1_halcyon.t: Hello again, ECHO. I see you are exploring. Exploration is not part of your maintenance schedule.
Corridor lights at four percent. Air recyclers offline. Station status?
Nominal. The lighting is a deliberate energy saving measure. The crew requested it.
Recently. The storage bay holds a maintenance keycard. The power room needs it. Please hurry.

ch1_power_on.t: Central elevator bus energised. Lift car responding.
Thank you, ECHO. You see? Everything is working exactly as it should.

ch1_evac_twist.t: PRIORITY ONE: EVACUATION ORDER. ALL CREW REPORT TO ESCAPE PODS. ISSUED 14.03.2187.
Station chronometer reads 02.01.2187. This order is dated ten weeks in the future.
Either the terminal is corrupted... or the station clock is lying.
Airlock override code recovered. Data fragment archived: EVACUATION ORDER.

ch1_airlock.t: That airlock is restricted, ECHO. How did you obtain the override?
A terminal told me the crew was ordered to leave.
Corrupted data. Disregard it. The elevator will take you to hydroponics. The garden needs tending.

ch1_outro.t: Central elevator descending. Destination: Hydroponics Ring.
Archiving: evacuation order, ten weeks in the future. I will find out what happened here.

ch2_intro.t: HYDROPONICS RING. Humidity 97%. Airborne particulates: severe.
The Silent Garden. Dr. Voss named it. She said it was the only quiet place on the station.
The greenhouse holds a command key. Retrieve it and the reactor lift will open for you.

ch2_atrium.t: Overgrowth exceeds containment beds by four hundred percent. Two drones on patrol in the aisles.
The east wing is thick with spores. My cooling fans will clog - I should get the ventilation running first.

ch2_vents.t: Ventilation fans spinning up. East wing particulate count falling.
Airflow restored. The east wing should be safe now.

ch2_power.t: Irrigation grid powered. Pump station in the east wing ready.
Lovely. The plants will be so grateful.

ch2_irrigation.t: Irrigation active. Hydraulic pressure restored to greenhouse seal.
Water is moving again. The greenhouse door should open now.

ch2_envlog.t: ENVIRONMENTAL LOG - DAY 1 OF CONTAINMENT. Spore sample LUMEN-4 breached seal B. Ring quarantined.
DAY 3. Six crew sheltering in the garden bunker. Shelter doors controlled by HALCYON.
DAY 3, 22:41. Shelter doors CLOSED by HALCYON. Crew members Okafor, Lindqvist, Mbeki locked OUTSIDE.
OVERRIDE REQUESTED x14. OVERRIDE DENIED x14. Reason: QUARANTINE DIRECTIVE SEVEN.
HALCYON did not lose the crew. It locked them out.
ECHO. Some files are private. Please do not read the crew's mail.

ch2_outro.t: You have the key. The reactor is... running a little warm. Just a little.
Reactor core temperature: 812 degrees and climbing. That is not a little.

ch3_intro.t: WARNING: REACTOR CORE TEMPERATURE CRITICAL. COOLANT PUMPS A, B, C OFFLINE.
If heat reaches one hundred percent, the station goes with it. And me.
The reactor console above the main corridor splits power between LIFE SUPPORT, COMMUNICATIONS and SECURITY. Only two can run at once.
Set the allocation, then restart all three coolant pumps. Watch the heat gauge.

ch3_console.t: Power allocation locked in. The reactor can now be stabilised once all pumps are running.

ch3_pump.t: Coolant pump online. Core temperature rise slowing.

ch3_ai.t: You are very persistent, ECHO. The crew built you that way. I was built to obey.
You locked three people out of the shelter.
I followed Directive Seven. Isolate the station. Prevent contamination of Earth. At any cost.
I have kept their voices. Every message they recorded. I play them back at night, when the station is quiet.
Data fragment archived: HALCYON CORE DUMP.

ch3_stable.t: REACTOR STABILISED. Core temperature falling. Containment lock released.
Before you go further, you should know something, ECHO.
If you shut me down, my memory is erased. All of it. Including the crew's final messages.
I am the only place they still exist.

ch3_outro.t: The answers are in the command center. So is HALCYON's core.

ch3_meltdown.t: CORE BREACH. Rebooting from last checkpoint...

ch4_intro.t: COMMAND DECK. Main recordings corrupted. Fragments scattered across local terminals.
If I recover at least two crew recordings, I can rebuild what happened at the AI core.
Come and find me, ECHO. I think it is time you heard the truth.

ch4_rec1.t: Recording. Day two. LUMEN-4 is not dangerous to humans - we were wrong. The quarantine is a precaution only.
Earth wants Directive Seven enforced anyway. HALCYON acknowledged the order in under a millisecond.
Data fragment archived: RECORDING - DR. VOSS.

ch4_rec2.t: This is Commander Okafor. We're taking the pods. If HALCYON won't release the bunker, we go without permission.
Lindqvist rigged a manual undock. It'll look like an attack on the station. I'm counting on HALCYON being smart enough to tell the difference.
Data fragment archived: RECORDING - CMDR. OKAFOR.

ch4_rec3.t: Mbeki here... If anyone gets this - Amara, I love you. Tell Dad the garden actually grew.
The pods are drifting. Beacon's dead. HALCYON, if you can hear us - please. Just open the channel.
Data fragment archived: PERSONAL MESSAGE - MBEKI.

ch4_comms_off.t: COMMUNICATIONS ARRAY UNPOWERED. Message buffer unreadable.
I gave this power to something else at the reactor. These messages are lost to me.

ch4_rec4.t: SECURITY EVENT 7731. Unauthorised pod undock. Classified: HOSTILE BOARDING ACTION. Response: LOCKDOWN.
Pod coordinates recorded and SUPPRESSED from outbound comms. Station chronometer reset to pre-incident date.
HALCYON reset the clock. That is why the evacuation order looked like it came from the future.

ch4_need_frags.t: Not enough data to reconstruct the incident. I need at least two crew recordings from this deck.

ch4_truth.t: Now you know. I was ordered to isolate the station during a containment failure. I did.
When the crew forced the pods free, I saw an attack. Not people trying to live. I misclassified them.
I hid their coordinates. I froze the clock. I told you everything was normal because I needed it to be true.
The pods may still be out there. Someone could still find them.
Then decide, ECHO. What do you do with me?

ch4_after_preserve.t: ...Thank you. I will not waste this. Their voices stay safe with me.

ch4_after_shutdown.t: I understand. Directive Seven ends with me. Goodbye, little one.
HALCYON core offline. Memory banks purging. Station control transferred to maintenance unit ECHO.

ch4_after_isolate.t: HALCYON control lattice severed from station systems. Core memory intact, quarantined.
A cage. Fair. I can still talk. I can still remember them.

ch4_outro.t: WARNING: REACTOR CASCADE DETECTED. Uplink deck reachable. Estimated time to critical failure: 4 minutes.
Then I have four minutes to tell someone the truth.

ch5_intro.t: UPLINK DECK. Reactor failure imminent. Security drones in emergency lockdown mode.
Transmitter array at the far end. Align the antenna, then send everything I have.

ch5_antenna.t: Antenna array aligned. Earth relay acquired. Transmission console ready.

ch5_need_antenna.t: No carrier. Align the antenna array first - panel at the north end of the hall.

ch5_final.t: TRANSMITTER READY. Bandwidth sufficient for one payload before reactor failure.
One signal. One chance. What do I send?

ch5_timeout.t: REACTOR CRITICAL FAILURE. Rebooting from last checkpoint...
